verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents inbound mechanisms: an API endpoint that external services such as GitHub or CI pipelines call to message Poke, plus a deprecated inbound-sms webhook endpoint. Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that let a programmatic consumer subscribe to Poke events. Inbound triggers are an adjacent capability and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
